notes:
1.3.1: clean day-per-page reports, Baselines window with multi-delete

- Word and PDF reports: cover page (title, period, name, big totals, light monthly table), then
  each day on its own page (busy days can run to a second page; empty days skipped). Clean
  layout: weekday label, large date, one accent rule, small coloured section labels, items
  with faint separators; labels never left alone at the bottom of a page. Option to turn off
  'each day on a new page'.
- Baselines window: save (with name), show/hide, rename, tick several and delete (with Undo);
  a bin next to the Baseline menu in the Plan view deletes the selected one.
